text:
oliver-sales: Heads-up: Optima demo in 15m. They report 403s when calling /v1/generate with the trial token. Can someone jump in?

jamie-eng: sure — can you paste the exact curl + response?

optima_dev: minimal repro (key redacted):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer rwd_trial_OPT123" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-mini","input":"ping"}'
```
raw response:
{"error":"invalid_token_binding","message":"token lacks project_id claim for project=optima-live","code":403}

jamie-eng: that error indicates the JWT doesn't contain the project_id claim matching the requested project. Are they hitting a project-bound endpoint or using a workspace key?

optima_dev: we only used the single trial key from sales email, no extra headers. Is a project header needed?

noah-support: Some trial keys are unbound and the system expects an explicit bind when multiple projects exist. Try adding these headers to bind the request: `-H "X-Redwood-Account: optima-acct" -H "X-Redwood-Project: optima-live"`. If that doesn't help I'll mint a project-scoped temp key.

infra-bot: policy-check: rejected request reason=project_claim_mismatch details="expected project_id=optima-live"

optima_dev: added headers and still 403 with same message.

noah-support: copying steps: I'll create a short-lived key scoped to optima-live with scopes: generate:invoke and embeddings:read. DMing the key to the contact in 2m.

jamie-eng: quick note for their client: ensure Authorization header is the only auth header the client signs; some SDKs accidentally strip custom headers when auto-retrying. Also limit parallel streaming to avoid hitting concurrency 429s.

optima_dev: temp key worked — responses succeed now. Two follow-ups from them on the call: 1) what are the exact scopes they need for a demo? 2) they saw occasional 429s during a scripted run.

noah-support: for demos, typical minimal scopes: ["generate:invoke","embeddings:read"]. 429s are rate limit / concurrency thresholds on trial plans. If they plan sustained load we can propose a reserved slot or a higher quota demo key for a day.

jamie-eng: adding a troubleshooting snippet to the POC playbook for sales:
```
# Bind headers for project-scoped tokens (if applicable)
-H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>"
-H "X-Redwood-Account: <account>"
-H "X-Redwood-Project: <project>"
```

noah-support: temp key TTL=1h created and DM'd. If they need 24h test key we can issue with manager approval. I'll also tag this error pattern so console alerts can detect spikes of "invalid_token_binding".

optima_dev: confirmed green on the call. We'll ask for a 24h test if we do a load-run overnight. Thanks all.

oliver-sales: great work. I'll follow up in the deal thread with pricing options (burst vs reserved) and add a note about sending a project-scoped sample key for future POCs. :thumbsup:
